## Install

```bash
npx skills add nanlabs/agent-toolkit -g
npx skills add nanlabs/agent-toolkit/plugins/nanlabs-delivery/skills
```

Or install the matching **group plugin** (see [Plugin Marketplace](Plugin-Marketplace)). Skills-only does **not** register MCP or agents.
